output.scope_note: The paper is about a computational method (PES, DP path search, NEB) for Li-ion activation energies in β-Li3PS4 and Li3YBr6, but it reports activation energies, not ionic conductivity values; its only conductivity mentions are generic class-level figures (e.g. "ca. 10 mS/cm" for sulfides, "approximately 1 mS/cm" for oxides/halides) with no specific material.
